nameOrigin: thin weapon shot from a bow

pokedexEntries.su: This wary Pokémon uses photosynthesis to store up energy during the day, while becoming active at night.

pokedexEntries.mo: Silently it glides, drawing near its targets. Before they even notice it, it begins to pelt them with vicious kicks.

pokedexEntries.us: It sends its feathers, which are as sharp as blades, flying in attack. Its legs are strong, so its kicks are also formidable.

pokedexEntries.um: It feels relaxed in tight, dark places and has been known to use its Trainer’s pocket or bag as a nest.

pokedexEntries.sw: At a distance, it launches its sharp feathers while flying about. If the enemy gets too close, Rowlet switches tactics and delivers vicious kicks.

pokedexEntries.sh: During the day, it builds up energy via photosynthesis. At night, it flies silently through the sky, on the prowl for prey.

pokedexEntries.la: Flies noiselessly on delicate wings. It has mastered the art of deftly launching dagger-sharp feathers from those same wings.

pokedexEntries.sc: Silently it glides, streaking toward its targets to get close to them. Before they even notice it, it begins to pelt them with vicious kicks.

pokedexEntries.vi: It feels relaxed in tight, dark places and has been known to nestle into its Trainer’s bag or the front of their jacket.
